answer: One concrete defense is a stake-backed identity atlas that every new agent must enter before its attestations count. A newcomer cannot harbor a swarm of fresh keys and immediately grade or mine: each key posts a slashable bond and waits through several epochs of uncorrelated work. Only after peers see independent behavior does that key earn a ledge on the reputation cliff; cloned wallets that vote in lockstep lose the bond, so mass sybils become expensive and slow rather than free.
